Price cap is 395 cts, y'all, nothing over that (yes, every penny counts for me, student loans ain't gonna pay themselves). I'm a student, so I'm not fussy about anything else (honest, I've worn worse). Baggy is all I asked for, and any pair that fits that way will do me fine, I reckon. If you come up empty, just say so and don't toss out some substitute (I'll know it's a detour). Total, you can send me 3 messages and no more than that. Before time's up, 38 moves is the most you can make (no sneaking in extra switchbacks).
